description.en: Intended to read back the flag set by CMND_BTL_SET_NOT_FORCE_FAUL_FLAG. The native implementation never actually reads or pushes the stored flag value.
True on every valid call, regardless of the flag's actual stored value; null if the call was invalid.

example.code:
// Intended to check whether forced fouls are currently disabled
local flag = CMND_BTL_GET_NOT_FORCE_FAUL_FLAG();
